mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces equity discount rates and increases equity attractiveness relative to bonds, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 0.2% in 80% of instances, yet 20-day forward returns negative in >40% of those instances (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL above 217.0 signals persistent inflation, triggering equity sell-offs due to rising real rates and margin pressure, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 217.0 in 80% of instances, yet 5-day forward returns positive in >40% of those instances (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signal robust economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days via stronger earnings expectations.
failure_condition: INDPRO and HOUST both increase >0.5% MoM in 80% of instances, yet 60-day forward returns negative in >40% of those instances (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.2% signals aggressive monetary policy, boosting equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 5.0 in 80% of instances, yet FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.2% occurs in 80% of those, but 20-day returns negative in >40% of those cases (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: PAYEMS above 131000.0 signals strong labor market conditions, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days via sustained earnings growth and reduced recession risk.
failure_condition: PAYEMS > 131000.0 in 80% of instances, yet 5-day forward returns negative in >40% of those instances (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.2% coupled with PAYEMS > 131000.0 signals coordinated monetary and labor policy response to economic weakness, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.2% and PAYEMS > 131000.0 in 80% of instances, yet 60-day forward returns negative in >40% of those instances (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: HOUST below 500.0 signals weakening real estate demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days via reduced consumer spending and economic slowdown expectations.
failure_condition: HOUST < 500.0 in 80% of instances, yet 20-day forward returns positive in >40% of those instances (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust economic growth and rising corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO above 99.0 in 80% of instances, yet 60-day forward returns negative in >40% of those instances (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).
